source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 13 (Al-Masjid). Exercises reused from the lesson; every clip reuses audio already approved/verified in isl1-l11, isl2-l11, isl2-l12.
topic: A clean, quiet place of worship: the right words and the right foot

learn.en: The Arabic word for mosque is masjid. It is a place where Muslims pray five times a day.
learn.title: A place for salah

learn.en: When it is time for salah, the mu'adh-dhin calls out the adhan from the masjid.
learn.title: The call to prayer

learn.en: Some mosques are small and some are very big. In a big mosque you will find many water taps, for making wudu before praying.
learn.title: Big and small mosques

learn.en: Enter the mosque with your right foot first, and say the du'aa.
learn.title: Entering with the right foot
learn.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ افْتَحْ لِي أَبْوَابَ رَحْمَتِكَ
learn.tr: Bismi-llāh, waṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalā rasūli-llāh. Allāhumma ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik

learn.en: Take off your shoes at the entrance. In the prayer hall, a niche called the mihrab shows the qiblah — the direction we pray towards.
learn.title: The mihrab shows the qiblah

learn.en: Before going to the mosque, make sure your body and clothes are clean and don't smell bad. Don't eat or drink in the mosque.
learn.title: A clean place of worship

learn.en: After salah, leave the mosque with your left foot first, and say the du'aa.
learn.title: Leaving with the left foot
learn.ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ، وَالصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللهِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
learn.tr: Bismi-llāh, waṣ-ṣalātu was-salāmu ʿalā rasūli-llāh. Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik

learn.en: “The mosques of Allah are only to be maintained by those who believe in Allah and the Last Day and establish prayer.” (Qur'an 9:18)
learn.title: From the Qur'an

words.en: the one who calls the adhan
Entering: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me
Leaving: O Allah, I ask You of Your bounty

quiz.en: True or false? It is OK to throw paper in the masjid.
True or false? We must keep our masjid clean.
True or false? I must take my shoes off inside the masjid.
True or false? The mihrab shows the qiblah.
Which foot do we enter the masjid with?
Which foot do we leave the masjid with?
True or false? Eating and drinking in the masjid is fine.

move.ar: اُدْخُلْ بِرِجْلِكَ اليُمْنَى، وَاخْرُجْ بِرِجْلِكَ اليُسْرَى!
move.en: Practise at a doorway: step in with your right foot, step out with your left!

think.q: Next time you visit the masjid, can you remember which foot to lead with, going in and coming out?
think.a: Right foot in with “Allāhumma ftaḥ lī abwāba raḥmatik”, left foot out with “Allāhumma innī asʾaluka min faḍlik”.

parents.summary: The masjid: the adhan, wudu taps, shoes off, the mihrab and qiblah, keeping clean, and the du'aas for entering (right foot) and leaving (left foot).

try.en: O Allah, open the gates of Your mercy for me

parents.tip: On your next visit to the masjid, let him lead with the right foot and say the du'aa at the door.
